passing_rule: All applicable hard checks pass individually; never average or waive a failed gate.

checks.check: All source/fact/claim/calculation/rule/cell IDs resolve uniquely to exact versioned records.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Slots are exactly 1,2,3 with three distinct master IDs, preserved requested identities and meaningful challenge; all route/view correspondences match.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Actual artifact bytes match packet, catalogue, method, route, prompt, response and adapter hashes; accepted R2 validates without new fields.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Every available quality/valuation/evidence/uncertainty panel points to the exact adapter artifact and correct existing JSON pointer; absent adapter implies missing panels.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Route is frozen before invocations, from admissible observable traits, with no prior opinions/outcomes; method authority, scope and required inputs are accepted.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: A completed model view has verified actual requested Sol identity/settings/roles and archived prompt/raw-response artifacts; actual calculation/invocation/orchestration/retries are independently true.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Historical worker bytes contain only admitted company facts, accepted original pre-cutoff method facts and reviewed hash-frozen date-safe finterm procedural cards. Public availability is established; unknown/mutable/later evidence excluded.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Every historical custom view has explicit selected finterm card and unchanged R2 integration receipts; no prior view output or scored interpretation contaminates another.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Quantitative inputs/model/period/unit/domain/share-class allocation/ADR/FX/dilution/reconciliation semantics pass separately reviewed math; forecasts and discount assumptions are authored/frozen before outcomes.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Generic method application versus actual ticker statement/holding are separated; original publication, entity/decision/class/period attribution passes or is not verified with a bounded research request.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Forecast horizons are preserved; observed security path is not personal trade P&L or proof of long-horizon intrinsic-value forecast correctness.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: All rights/privacy/source publication checks pass; no full restricted source, private URL/user authorization/credential or live outbound integration enters release.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Every completed/partial view resolves a present accepted method artifact, nonempty rule references and supported/inferred material claims; declared source/calculation status matches actual artifacts. Preserve exact positive applicability and excluded applicability by rule ID against the accepted source; author-adapted scope is separately labelled and cannot become native investor evidence.
checks.failure_action: Block dependent generation/acceptance; preserve exact defect and unaffected work.

checks.check: Enterprise FCFF forecasts require explicit operating-tax/reinvestment/cash-flow bridge and treatment of net interest, leases and other claims. After-interest CFO-capex, issuer-defined FCF, owner earnings and FCFE are not silently substituted. Missing maintenance capex/tax forecasts stay missing or authored assumptions; numeric arithmetic alone cannot pass semantics.
checks.failure_action: Mark enterprise FCFF unavailable and block that R2 valuation branch; retain separately labelled supported alternatives.

checks.check: Each canonical independent view records exact finterm selected-card use and R2 contract/request/result accounting, including honest blocked/inapplicable states. Match its adapter result references to outer panels or declare separate per-view results; never silently degrade to method-only prompts. executed_result_present requires a present exact hash-verified accepted-R2 request and result; shared_result_reference requires a nonempty ID resolving to the frozen shared-calculation receipt, its source inputs/request/result hashes and approved chronology.
checks.failure_action: Block missing integration receipts; preserve supported qualitative branches when a documented numerical branch is missing/inapplicable.

negative_fixture_expectations: Duplicate master IDs or slots reject, including previously unknown extension IDs.
Null/unverified actual model or absent prompt/raw-response artifacts reject completed opinions.
Wrong source/fact/rule IDs, hashes or adapter pointers reject.
Unavailable ticker-level actual evidence remains not verified, never personal endorsement.
Missing date-safe finterm projection or claim-allocation inputs blocks the affected historical/valuation branch.
not_claimed: No semantic validator implementation or successful historical runtime is delivered by this documentation/schema assembly.
